topics.title: One rush order reshuffles everything — how much flex can scheduling actually take?
topics.supplement: When an urgent order cuts in, how much of the plant schedule has to be torn down and rebuilt? How much capacity disappears each month into changeovers, line cleaning and material swaps?

topics.title: Fragmented, opaque data — can the impact of a rush order even be measured?
topics.supplement: When a customer urgently asks about lead time, stock and capacity, how many systems do you have to cross-check before you dare answer? Of the delivery risk, capacity load and cost swing an expedite triggers, what can you quantify and what is guesswork?

topics.title: A plan that looks good but never lands — how do you prove scheduling’s value?
topics.supplement: How many percentage points separate plan attainment on paper from what the shop floor actually completes? Of the cost savings, efficiency gains and on-time delivery, how much can honestly be credited to scheduling?
